emma: FYI saw intermittent p99 spikes on some 8k sessions during the 02:00 UTC peak. uploaded flamegraphs and perf traces.
raj: which phase is the culprit? prefill or decode?
emma: prefill dominates for the worst hosts. quick kernel breakdown from profiler:
- fused-int8: prefill ~65%, decode ~25%
- unfused-fp16: prefill ~40%, decode ~52%
nina: so unfused shifts more into decode. any KV-cache signal?
emma: yep. cold sessions show ~20% KV miss on initial chunks, warmed sessions <4%.
liam: can you paste the perf command used?
emma: sure:
```
./perf/run --model=redwood-v2-8k-qint8 --seq=8192 --batch=4 --traces=flame
```
raj: you swept microbatch sizes?
emma: ran 1,2,4,8. behavior flips at >4 for fused-int8: batching helps throughput but p99 worsens when KV-miss rate is elevated.
nina: hypothesis: fused-int8 prefill has a serialized hotspot (KV fetch + kernel setup) that amplifies tail when misses occur.
raj: matches earlier kernel-switch lock symptoms we saw.
liam: numbers?
emma: sample run (8k, batch=8): p95=118ms, p99=385ms. batch=2: p95=160ms, p99=205ms. so smaller batch lowers tail but hurts p95/throughput.
perf-bot: perf alert: regression detected on fused-int8 prefill (+45% p99 vs baseline).
nina: possible mitigations:
A) adaptive microbatch cap (lower max batch for flows with many in-flight tokens)
B) async KV prefetch at kernel-level to hide misses
C) fallback to unfused-fp16 for sessions flagged as cold
D) warmup probe (small prefix) to pre-warm KV on session creation
raj: prioritize B and C. async prefetch should reduce tail without large throughput penalty. fallback is low-risk.
liam: ops: add a request header like X-Session-Cold that lets router pick kernel variant.
emma: also propose new metric: per-session prefill/decode split + KSLO (kernel-specific latency objective) to gate batch sizing.
nina: experiment plan:
1) implement KV-prefetch shim (non-blocking) and measure p99 improvement on fused-int8
2) runtime switch to route new sessions to unfused-fp16 until KV warm
3) microbatch sweep with adaptive cap policy
raj: simulate at scale with replay of ~10k sessions, cold ratio ~15%?
emma: yes, will run replay tomorrow and post results.
liam: add alert if p99 > 300ms for >5m across any host group.
perf-bot: note: previous sims showed fallback to unfused raised GPU cycles ~12% avg.
nina: tradeoffs noted. if prefetch tames tail we can keep larger microbatches and preserve throughput.
emma: TL;DR: prefill hotspots on fused-int8 + cold KV misses driving tails. next steps: async KV prefetch + cold-session fallback + adaptive batch cap. I'll open a PR with perf harness and experiment checklist.
raj: pls tag me on PR, I can help tune kernel heuristics.
liam: adding ops rollback steps to runbook in case throughput regresses.
perf-bot: experiment ticket PERF-5172 created.
emma: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
